$comment: Newly authored DL-045 owner contract; TEST_ONLY qualification does not install a source or admit an event. Whole native roots and all independently acquired source values in resource-bank.json are mandatory in addition to these closed durable joins. No SourceMember or hash is native authority.

StoppedRowMetadata.$comment: SP-428 value delta for a stopped row, copied from the verified original goal_run.stopped v3 row only; the enum is the v3 payload enum (checked equal by ATS-1112).

BlockedRowMetadata.$comment: SP-428 value delta for a blocked row, copied from the verified original goal_run.blocked v3 row only; the enum is the v3 payload enum (checked equal by ATS-1112).

ConsumerRequest.$comment: The only caller input of a fresh stop/block consumer method; every source below is owner-acquired.

PrefixFrame.$comment: One frame of the actual global Event prefix, read whole from Storage custody (SP-278, SP-286); off-run frames are validated before they are treated as no-ops.

NativeChronologyStep.$comment: One authenticated D01 update of the run; GRS-202 accepts a gap between the projected and a row's expected revision only across original_execution_progress and original_provisional_success steps.

StopBlockSources.$comment: Own stop/block source bundle returned by owner.storage.goal_run.stop_block.read_sources.v1; inherited started/cancelled/certified sources are separate arguments in the fresh consumer realms.

ProjectionState.$comment: Whole own preimages read in the publishing transaction (SB5 CAS); null only for a genuinely absent key.

Halt.$comment: A row the reducer does not support halts before it; nothing is committed for it.
